verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms https://typesense.org/llms.txt returns HTTP 200 with agent-oriented content ("search engine for developers and AI agents"). The docs also offer agent-friendly formats: a "Copy Markdown" option on doc pages, .md-served guides (e.g. mcp-server.md), and a "Typesense for AI Agents" guide. missing for 10: evidence of the llms.txt's full contents and coverage, a root docs markdown index (/docs/.md returned 404), and independent or hands-on corroboration of agents using these docs.
